rules.action: Maintain normal automatic voltage regulation (AVR) and tap changer operation.
Inhibit tap changes that aggravate transmission lines, activate capacitor banks, and adjust generator reactive power setpoints.
Initiate emergency Under-Voltage Load Shedding (UVLS) to prevent voltage collapse.
Switch off capacitor banks, adjust shunt reactors, and decrease generator excitation levels.
Trip affected transmission lines or substations to prevent insulation failure and equipment damage.
